# Office Math fixtures

Each file is a `.docx` whose `docProps/app.xml` `Application` is `Microsoft Office Word` or `Microsoft Word`, and whose `word/document.xml` contains `m:oMath`. Element counts are every element in the OMML namespace (`http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/math`, or the strict `http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/math` namespace in `strict-binomial.docx`).
